question: How does BSP scale CET across the Northeast?
html:
BSP scales CET in three phases: make Massachusetts and Connecticut one company, buy founder-owned contractors in the other four New England states, then shift the mix toward recurring service. The target is about 3x revenue in 36 months (est.), modelled on BSP's Smith + Howard exit to TPG (CET growth plan).

Starting point and targets

CET's baseline is a low-confidence estimate from filings: 260-290 people, $65-100M pro forma revenue and $6-11M EBITDA after NuWave and Horton. None of this is disclosed by CET or BSP (CET growth plan).

MonthRevenue (est.)EBITDA (est.)Headcount (est.)Locations
0$80M$8.0M2754
12$115M$12.1M3907
24$170M$19.5M56010
36$240M$30.0M78013

These are planning assumptions, not guidance (CET growth plan).

Phase 1: integrate MA and CT

  • Horton nearly doubles the workforce and brings Connecticut wastewater relationships (CET growth plan).
  • The plan points Horton at 62 funded or requested plant and pump-station projects in CT, MA and RI, led by New Haven, Hartford and Norwalk (CET growth plan).
  • The near-term pipeline includes Fairfield pump stations and the WPCF (about $36.1M) and Danbury electrical resiliency (about $3.2M) (CET opportunity radar).
  • Month 12 assumes about 8% organic growth plus two tuck-ins (est.).

Phase 2: buy into four states

  • CET's six-state licensing supports add-ons in RI, NH, ME and VT. The target screen has 48 companies with a median of about $15.1M (CET growth plan).
  • Competing sponsors named in the plan are Pfingsten's NEC Group and Ridgemont's Crete United.
  • The current top ten is mostly Massachusetts. McDonald Electrical and K.M. Kelly lead with fit scores of 83 (CET add-on targets).
  • Revenue figures in the screen are ZoomInfo models and need diligence.
  • Coverage of the four expansion states is thin: RI 4 items, NH 5, ME 16 and VT 9 (CET opportunity radar).

Phase 3: shift to recurring service

  • The service lines are SCADA and pump-station monitoring, solar and storage O&M, EV depot charging and NuWave efficiency.
  • The goal is about 25% recurring mix by month 36 (est.). Brokers price that mix 3 or more turns above project-heavy contractors (CET growth plan).
  • Data-center work is a real upside in PJM but thin in New England, per ISO-NE (CET growth plan).
  • Census residential permits are not a demand signal for this plan. To size the service upside, BSP needs CET's current contract mix by revenue type.

Next actions

  • Today, Oct 8, 2026: confirm submission of the Massport Worcester airport RFQ and the BPS and Campbell generator bids. Submit the SRTA New Bedford DCFC bid by Oct 9, 2026 (CET opportunity radar).
  • By Oct 15, 2026: put Horton's CT team on the River Road pump station bid. Book engineer-of-record meetings for Fairfield, South Windsor, West Haven and Danbury.
  • Phase 2 pipeline: build an RI, NH, ME and VT target list. Pull verified financials on McDonald and K.M. Kelly.
  • Baseline data: replace the estimated starting figures with CET's actual trailing financials and revenue mix.
